page.overview:
What is Barad Nimras?

Barad Nimras was a tower on Bar-in-Mŷl westward of Eglarest, that was built by Finrod in the year FA 65 of the First Age.

It was built to keep watch, should Morgoth try to assail them from the sea; though it proved needless, as Morgoth and his servants never attempted war by the sea, fearing it.

Its purpose was to keep watch on the western seas, and warn of any naval attack by Morgoth's forces. As Morgoth never mounted any attack from the ocean, the tower was never in fact needed.

However, in the year after the Nirnaeth Arnoediad, Morgoth did launch a land-based attack on Eglarest and Brithombar, and Barad Nimras was torn down at that time by the very foes it was meant to guard against.
